lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
lines.english: How many people are in your family?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我家有五口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、妹妹和我。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén: bàba, māma, gēge, mèimei hé wǒ.
lines.english: There are five people in my family: dad, mom, older brother, younger sister, and me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 你哥哥多大？他在做什么工作？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ gēge duō dà? Tā zài zuò shénme gōngzuò?
lines.english: How old is your older brother? What work does he do?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 他二十五岁。他是医生，在医院工作。
lines.pinyin: Tā èrshíwǔ suì. Tā shì yīshēng, zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
lines.english: He is 25 years old. He is a doctor, works at a hospital.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ mèimei ne? Tā duō dà le?
lines.english: What about your younger sister? How old is she?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 她十八岁。她是学生，在大学学习汉语。
lines.pinyin: Tā shíbā suì. Tā shì xuésheng, zài dàxué xuéxí Hànyǔ.
lines.english: She is 18. She is a student, studying Chinese at university.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What about your dad and mom?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 爸爸是老师，妈妈在家做饭。他们都很好。
lines.pinyin: Bàba shì lǎoshī, māma zài jiā zuòfàn. Tāmen dōu hěn hǎo.
lines.english: Dad is a teacher, mom cooks at home. They are both well.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hěn ài nǐ de jiārén ma?
lines.english: Do you love your family very much?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是的，我非常爱他们。我们一起吃饭、看电视。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, wǒ fēicháng ài tāmen. Wǒmen yìqǐ chīfàn, kàn diànshì.
lines.english: Yes, I love them very much. We eat and watch TV together.
